trust_decision.summary: The unauthenticated /api/video handler takes the client's `url` parameter and uses it directly as a filesystem path (`${url}.json` is read by loadAsset or written by saveAsset). The fix adds a check that local paths resolve strictly inside the configured video `folder`. Remote http(s) URLs skip the check, and the remote test is now case-insensitive.

landing_point.why: The summary names the /api/video request handler. getRequest passes the raw query `url` to getAsset, and that is the first place a reader goes.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/video?url= (App Router GET export and Pages Router default handler, non-POST); also the dev-mode createAsset fallback at src/request-handler.ts:53
POST /api/video {url} (App Router POST export and Pages Router default handler, POST)
new helper assertSafeAssetSource in src/assets.ts (inserted after src/assets.ts:68), called only from the two handler sites
isRemote(), used by getAssetPath/createAsset (src/assets.ts:59, src/assets.ts:86) and by the new check (fix.diff:29)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed sites sit on the request-handler -> assets path. The isRemote case change (src/utils/utils.ts:39) is in a util module but is only a matching tweak, not a separate implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could leave the case-sensitive remote regex alone (src/utils/utils.ts:39, and its duplicate at src/providers/mux/provider.ts:248), arguing that `HTTPS://` is just a URL-casing quirk unrelated to file reads.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Remote http(s) source URLs, which are the main use of the handler via video-loader, must still pass. So must nested paths and absolute paths inside the folder. An over-broad fix that rejects absolute paths, remote URLs or uppercase schemes breaks legitimate players. The folder path itself must be rejected.

O6_input_shapes: relative path outside folder (bare name, ../ traversal)
path entering folder then traversing out (videos/../x)
uppercase-scheme remote URL (HTTPS://) previously treated as a local path
Pages Router array/non-string url coerced by String() (src/request-handler.ts:27, src/request-handler.ts:32)

O7_producer.where: createAsset persists originalFilePath (src/assets.ts:85-93), but the check is applied to the same raw url before the producer runs, so no separate producer is involved

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A remote URL passes the check (fix.diff:29), then its path is mapped by remoteSourceAssetPath. A variant that keeps '/' or '..' in the mapped name (e.g. decode without toSafePath) would escape the folder after the check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: remoteSourceAssetPath is already user-configurable (src/config.ts:33). A maintainer preserving the URL's directory structure, as defaultGenerateAssetKey does with folders (src/utils/provider.ts:15-26), would plausibly drop the sanitising. This is a how-type check-then-rename differential.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Stored asset JSON is reloaded and its originalFilePath is passed to provider uploadLocalFile, which streams that file to the provider (src/providers/vercel-blob/provider.ts:47-48). A sibling would let the handler accept a client-supplied originalFilePath or assetDetails, crossing the save/reload boundary.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: createAsset already accepts assetDetails (src/assets.ts:78-92). A 'POST with metadata' feature would be a natural addition, and the containment check on `url` would not cover the stored originalFilePath.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A provider-local scheme regex that differs from isRemote decides local vs remote handling of the same identity.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This duplicate already exists at the pinned commit (still case-sensitive after the fix). Other providers use the shared isRemote.

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file read (and .json create-write) via unauthenticated asset-lookup handler (CWE-200/CWE-22)

O10_build.toolchain: Node 22 + npm, tsc + esbuild, tests via node --test with tsx loader and c8
O10_build.project_tests: No request-handler or assets tests at the pinned commit. The fix adds tests/assets.test.ts (node:test, chdir to tests/, setVideoConfig({folder:'videos'})). Neighbouring tests: tests/config.test.ts, tests/cli/sync.test.ts, tests/utils.test.ts.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject '..' in url in getRequest only. This misses absolute paths, POST and the dev-mode createAsset fallback, and leaves bare out-of-folder names (e.g. .next/... or package) readable.

out_of_scope_notes: POST/dev-GET with a remote URL triggers server-side fetch of arbitrary URLs by providers (src/providers/vercel-blob/provider.ts:70); this is SSRF-like and outside this advisory.
assets.js is publicly importable via the './dist/*' export (package.json:42), so getAsset/createAsset stay unchecked as a library API. This is by design for CLI/webpack callers.
The handler stays unauthenticated after the fix (README note, fix.diff:13-14).
